title: Flare
summary: A team project that helps local communities explore fragmented wildfire information in one place. It combines a map, risk indicators, related news, a wildfire-focused AI chatbot, and web push notifications in an installable web application.

projectIntro.title: Project overview
projectIntro.description: When wildfire locations, risk information, and related news live in separate channels, users have to assemble the situation themselves. I helped design one experience that connects the core information, follow-up questions, and notifications.

product.label: Product
product.description: An installable web application for exploring wildfire information and related questions

users.label: Users
users.description: Local users who want to review wildfire locations, risk indicators, and related news in one place

role.label: My scope
role.description: Designed and implemented major full-stack features including PWA installation, a wildfire-focused AI chatbot, and web push notifications

problem.title: Problem and requirements
problem.description: Users needed a quicker way to understand wildfire information from several sources and return to the service from mobile devices.

fragmentedInformation.title: Fragmented wildfire information
fragmentedInformation.description: When locations, risk indicators, and related news are separate, users must move between sources and assemble the situation themselves.

deviceAccess.title: Access across devices
deviceAccess.description: The same capabilities needed to work on desktop and mobile, with browser installation available on supported devices.

focusedQuestions.title: Follow-up information
focusedQuestions.description: Users needed a supporting channel for questions that a map and news feed alone could not answer, while keeping the topic focused on wildfires.

design.title: Design and technical decisions
design.description: I placed information exploration, installation, and follow-up questions inside one disaster-information experience.

unifiedView.title: Map-centered unified view
unifiedView.description: Wildfire locations and risk indicators are presented on a map, with related news available in the same exploration flow.

installableWeb.title: PWA installation
installableWeb.description: I used a PWA to retain a web codebase while enabling installation from supported mobile and desktop browsers.

scopedAssistant.title: Wildfire-scoped chatbot
scopedAssistant.description: Instead of a general-purpose chatbot, I constrained the prompt role and response scope to wildfire-related questions.

implementation.title: Core implementation
implementation.description: I connected map and news data, AI conversation, installation, and notifications in one full-stack application.

mapAndRisk.title: Wildfire map and risk indicators
mapAndRisk.description: I presented wildfire information in a map interface so users could review location and risk level together.

newsPipeline.title: Related-news collection
newsPipeline.description: I connected related stories collected through the Bing News API and a web crawler to the application.

chatbot.title: Wildfire-focused AI chatbot
chatbot.description: I used the OpenAI API to implement a conversation experience for follow-up wildfire questions.

notifications.title: Web push notifications
notifications.description: I used Firebase to deliver wildfire-related notifications to supported browsers.

outcome.title: Implementation outcome
outcome.description: The main wildfire-information capabilities are available in one service that users can revisit from desktop and mobile environments.

consolidatedAccess.title: Consolidated information flow
consolidatedAccess.description: The map, risk indicators, and related news are available within one screen flow.

installableExperience.title: Installable web experience
installableExperience.description: The product retains a web architecture while supporting installation to the home screen or application list in compatible browsers.

focusedSupport.title: Extended through questions and notifications
focusedSupport.description: The experience goes beyond static information by supporting wildfire-focused questions and web push notifications.

walkthrough.title: Product walkthrough
walkthrough.description: The videos demonstrate the implemented screens and user flows in the web and installed experiences.
